concerns.text: Task T008 only specifies Wilcoxon signed‑rank analysis and Cliff’s Δ reporting. The specification (FR‑005, Constitution Principle VII) requires secondary Mann‑Whitney U and Kolmogorov‑Smirnov tests, as well as a Holm‑Bonferroni correction across all metric families. The current deliverable and verification steps do not produce or check these required analyses, making the task incomplete and unexecutable with respect to the spec.

Verification for T008 records p‑value, effect size, corrected α and conclusion text, but does not verify that the effect‑size meets the threshold |Cliff’s Δ| > 0.14 (SC‑003). Without this check the task cannot guarantee compliance with the success criterion, so the verification is insufficient.
